meta.title: UI tokens — Arrow Out (working title in code; the original is "Maze Out! - Tap Puzzle")
meta.role: UI MEASUREMENT (start of SPEC-ui); the SPEC-ui writer extends this with the meta explorer captures

safeArea.note: the original hides the iOS status bar in every captured screen; content uses the full 852 pt height (coin pill at y 30 pt sits beside the Dynamic Island)

font.note: Nunito wght 1000 (OFL), every UI role; see design/fonts.md

meta.sources: research/shots/*.png (lossless runner shots) + research/kickoff/state.png; store-6 for the Streak Race panel only
meta.method: design/ui-crops/_tools (mlib.py, measure.py, m_*.py, build_tokens.py); see design/ui-measure.md
meta.units: frame_pt = [x, y, w, h] from the top-left of the 393 x 852 pt canvas; 1 px = 0.334 pt (+-0.35 pt edge precision)
meta.copying_line: crops in design/ui-crops are references to LOOK at; nothing here is an asset
meta.brand: the game is named "Arrow Out" (owner, 2026-09-25): every "MAZE OUT!" logo/lettering position below is a slot for OUR logo
